ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

ops.oldText: Customer Data remains governed by Sections 11 and 15.
ops.newText: Customer Data remains governed by Sections 10.3 and 15.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends our access but gives us no exit help or data-retrieval right, so we have added 10.3: up to 6 months' transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. We also corrected the broken cross-reference in 16.5 (there is no Section 11) to point at the new exit clause.
